            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">delete</span>
            Delete Customer
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Invoices Section */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col pr-4">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 shrink-0">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Invoices</h3>
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {invoices.length} {invoices.length === 1 ? 'invoice' : 'invoices'}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-auto bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-sm">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full">
              <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 z-10">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Invoice #</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Month</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Base Price</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">GST</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">QST</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Total</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Payment Status</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Payment Date</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-700">
                {invoices.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="9" className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      No invoices found for this customer.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  invoices.map((invoice) => {
                    const paymentStatus = invoice.payment?.payment_status || 'pending';
                    const paymentDate = invoice.payment?.payment_date
                      ? formatDate(invoice.payment.payment_date)
                      : '—';

                    return (
                      <tr key={invoice.invoice_number} className="hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {invoice.invoice_number}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatDate(invoice.month)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.base_price)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.gst)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.qst)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.total_price)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${getPaymentStatusClass(paymentStatus)}`}>
                            {paymentStatus}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {paymentDate}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <button
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                            title="Edit invoice"
                          >
                            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400 hover:text-primary text-lg">edit</span>
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// Customer API
export const customerApi = {
  async getAll() {
    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/customers`, {
        signal: controller.signal
      });
      clearTimeout(timeout);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching customers:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async create(customer) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/customers`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(customer),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding customer:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async update(id, customer) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/customers/${id}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(customer),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating customer:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
};

// Invoice API
export const invoiceApi = {
  async getAll() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async getByCustomer(customerId) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/customer/${customerId}`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching customer invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async create(invoice) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(invoice),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async fetchFilteredInvoices(filters) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/filter`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(filters),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching filtered invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async update(invoiceNumber, invoice) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/${invoiceNumber}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(invoice),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
};

// Payment API
export const paymentApi = {
  async getByInvoice(invoiceNumber) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/payments/invoice/${invoiceNumber}`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        if (response.status === 404) {
          return null;
        }
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching payment:', error);
      return null;
    }
  },

  async create(payment) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/payments`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payment),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating payment:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async update(paymentId, payment) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/payments/${paymentId}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payment),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating payment:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
};

import Modal from '@components/common/Modal';

export default function CustomerModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSave, customer }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    address: '',
    notes: ''
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (customer) {
      setFormData({
        name: customer.name || '',
        email: customer.email || '',
        phone: customer.phone || '',
        address: customer.address || '',
        notes: customer.notes || ''
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        email: '',
        phone: '',
        address: '',
        notes: ''
      });
    }
  }, [customer, isOpen]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await onSave(formData);
    handleClose();
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setFormData({
      name: '',
      email: '',
      phone: '',
      address: '',
      notes: ''
    });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      isOpen={isOpen}
      onClose={handleClose}
      title={customer ? 'Update Customer' : 'Add New Customer'}
    >
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="customerName">Name</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            id="customerName"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            required
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="customerEmail">Email</label>
          <input
            type="email"
            id="customerEmail"
            value={formData.email}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="customerPhone">Phone</label>
          <input
            type="tel"
            id="customerPhone"
            value={formData.phone}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="customerAddress">Address</label>
          <textarea
            id="customerAddress"
            rows="3"
            value={formData.address}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, address: e.target.value })}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="customerNotes">Notes</label>
          <textarea
            id="customerNotes"
            rows="3"
            value={formData.notes}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, notes: e.target.value })}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={handleClose}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
            Save Customer
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

import Modal from '@components/common/Modal';

export default function InvoiceModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSave, customerId }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    invoiceNumber: '',
    month: '',
    basePrice: '',
    gst: '',
    qst: '',
    totalPrice: ''
  });

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const invoiceNumber = parseInt(formData.invoiceNumber);
    const basePrice = parseFloat(formData.basePrice);
    const gst = parseFloat(formData.gst);
    const qst = parseFloat(formData.qst);
    const totalPrice = parseFloat(formData.totalPrice);

    // Validation
    if (!Number.isInteger(invoiceNumber) || invoiceNumber < 1) {
      alert('Invoice number must be a positive integer');
      return;
    }

    if (basePrice < 0 || gst < 0 || qst < 0 || totalPrice < 0) {
      alert('All price fields must be non-negative');
      return;
    }

    const checkDecimals = (value) => {
      const decimals = value.toString().split('.')[1];
      return !decimals || decimals.length <= 2;
    };

    if (!checkDecimals(basePrice) || !checkDecimals(gst) ||
        !checkDecimals(qst) || !checkDecimals(totalPrice)) {
      alert('Price values can have at most 2 decimal places');
      return;
    }

    const newInvoice = {
      invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
      customer_id: customerId,
      month: formData.month,
      base_price: basePrice.toFixed(2),
      gst: gst.toFixed(2),
      qst: qst.toFixed(2),
      total_price: totalPrice.toFixed(2)
    };

    try {
      await onSave(newInvoice);
      handleClose();
    } catch (error) {
      alert(`Error creating invoice: ${error.message}`);
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setFormData({
      invoiceNumber: '',
      month: '',
      basePrice: '',
      gst: '',
      qst: '',
      totalPrice: ''
    });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={handleClose} title="Generate New Invoice">
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="invoiceNumber">Invoice Number</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="invoiceNumber"
            value={formData.invoiceNumber}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, invoiceNumber: e.target.value })}
            required
            min="1"
            step="1"
          />
          <small>Must be a positive integer</small>
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="invoiceMonth">Month</label>
          <input
            type="date"
            id="invoiceMonth"
            value={formData.month}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, month: e.target.value })}
            required
          />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="invoiceBasePrice">Base Price ($)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="invoiceBasePrice"
            value={formData.basePrice}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, basePrice: e.target.value })}
            required
            min="0"
            step="0.01"
          />
          <small>Format: 0.00</small>
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="invoiceGST">GST ($)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="invoiceGST"
            value={formData.gst}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst: e.target.value })}
            required
            min="0"
            step="0.01"
          />
          <small>Format: 0.00</small>
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="invoiceQST">QST ($)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="invoiceQST"
            value={formData.qst}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, qst: e.target.value })}
            required
            min="0"
            step="0.01"
          />
          <small>Format: 0.00</small>
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="invoiceTotalPrice">Total Price ($)</label>
          <input
            type="number"
            id="invoiceTotalPrice"
            value={formData.totalPrice}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, totalPrice: e.target.value })}
            required
            min="0"
            step="0.01"
          />
          <small>Format: 0.00</small>
        </div>
        <div className="form-actions">
          <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={handleClose}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary">
            Create Invoice
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

export default function CustomerModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSave, customer }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    address: '',
    notes: ''
  });
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (customer) {
      setFormData({
        name: customer.name || '',
        email: customer.email || '',
        phone: customer.phone || '',
        address: customer.address || '',
        notes: customer.notes || ''
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        email: '',
        phone: '',
        address: '',
        notes: ''
      });
    }
  }, [customer, isOpen]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await onSave(formData);
      handleClose();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving customer:', error);
      alert(`Error saving customer: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }

    setFormData({

      address: '',

        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}

        <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-primary">person</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              {customer ? 'Update Customer' : 'Add New Customer'}
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleClose}
            className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6">
          <div className="space-y-5">
            {/* Name */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="customerName"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Name <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="customerName"
                value={formData.name}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                required
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                placeholder="Enter customer name"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Email */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label

                Email
              </label>
              <input
                type="email"
                id="customerEmail"
                value={formData.email}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"

              />
            </div>

            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="customerPhone"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Phone
              </label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                id="customerPhone"
                value={formData.phone}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                placeholder="(123) 456-7890"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Address */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="customerAddress"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Address
              </label>
              <textarea
                id="customerAddress"
                rows="3"
                value={formData.address}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, address: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all resize-none"
                placeholder="Enter customer address"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Notes */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label

                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, notes: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all resize-none"
                placeholder="Additional notes about the customer"

          <div className="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              className="flex-1 px-6 py-3 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button

              className="flex-1 px-6 py-3 bg-primary hover:bg-sky-600 text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center gap-2"

                  Saving...

                <>
                  <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">save</span>
                  Save Customer
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

{ useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export default function InvoiceModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSave, customerId, invoice }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    invoiceNumber: '',
    month: '',
    basePrice: '',
    gst: '',
    qst: '',
    totalPrice: ''
  });
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (invoice) {
      // Editing existing invoice
      setFormData({
        invoiceNumber: invoice.invoice_number || '',
        month: invoice.month ? invoice.month.split('T')[0] : '',
        basePrice: invoice.base_price || '',
        gst: invoice.gst || '',
        qst: invoice.qst || '',
        totalPrice: invoice.total_price || ''
      });
    } else {
      // New invoice - reset form
      setFormData({
        invoiceNumber: '',
        month: '',
        basePrice: '',
        gst: '',
        qst: '',
        totalPrice: ''
      });
    }
  }, [invoice, isOpen]);

  // Auto-calculate taxes and total when base price changes
  const handleBasePriceChange = (value) => {
    const base = parseFloat(value) || 0;
    const gstAmount = (base * 0.05).toFixed(2);
    const qstAmount = (base * 0.09975).toFixed(2);
    const total = (base + parseFloat(gstAmount) + parseFloat(qstAmount)).toFixed(2);

    setFormData({
      ...formData,
      basePrice: value,
      gst: gstAmount,
      qst: qstAmount,
      totalPrice: total
    });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const invoiceNumber = parseInt(formData.invoiceNumber);
      const basePrice = parseFloat(formData.basePrice);
      const gst = parseFloat(formData.gst);
      const qst = parseFloat(formData.qst);
      const totalPrice = parseFloat(formData.totalPrice);

      // Validation
      if (!Number.isInteger(invoiceNumber) || invoiceNumber < 1) {
        alert('Invoice number must be a positive integer');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      if (basePrice < 0 || gst < 0 || qst < 0 || totalPrice < 0) {
        alert('All price fields must be non-negative');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const checkDecimals = (value) => {
        const decimals = value.toString().split('.')[1];
        return !decimals || decimals.length <= 2;
      };

      if (!checkDecimals(basePrice) || !checkDecimals(gst) ||
          !checkDecimals(qst) || !checkDecimals(totalPrice)) {
        alert('Price values can have at most 2 decimal places');
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const invoiceData = {
        invoice_number: invoiceNumber,
        customer_id: customerId,
        month: formData.month,
        base_price: basePrice.toFixed(2),
        gst: gst.toFixed(2),
        qst: qst.toFixed(2),
        total_price: totalPrice.toFixed(2)
      };

      await onSave(invoiceData);
      handleClose();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error saving invoice:', error);
      alert(`Error saving invoice: ${error.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setFormData({
      invoiceNumber: '',
      month: '',
      basePrice: '',
      gst: '',
      qst: '',
      totalPrice: ''
    });
    onClose();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4"
      onClick={handleClose}
    >
      <div
        className="bg-white dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-2xl max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-6 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-primary/10 rounded-xl">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-primary">receipt</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              {invoice ? 'Update Invoice' : 'Generate New Invoice'}
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleClose}
            className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6">
          <div className="space-y-5">
            {/* Invoice Number */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="invoiceNumber"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Invoice Number <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                id="invoiceNumber"
                value={formData.invoiceNumber}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, invoiceNumber: e.target.value })}
                required
                min="1"
                step="1"
                disabled={!!invoice}
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                placeholder="Enter invoice number"
              />
              <small className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1 block">
                Must be a positive integer
              </small>
            </div>

            {/* Month */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="invoiceMonth"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Month <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="date"
                id="invoiceMonth"
                value={formData.month}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, month: e.target.value })}
                required
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Base Price */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="invoiceBasePrice"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Base Price ($) <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                id="invoiceBasePrice"
                value={formData.basePrice}
                onChange={(e) => handleBasePriceChange(e.target.value)}
                required
                min="0"
                step="0.01"
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                placeholder="0.00"
              />
              <small className="text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1 block">
                GST and QST will be calculated automatically
              </small>
            </div>

            {/* GST */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="invoiceGST"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                GST (5%) ($) <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                id="invoiceGST"
                value={formData.gst}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, gst: e.target.value })}
                required
                min="0"
                step="0.01"
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                placeholder="0.00"
                readOnly
              />
            </div>

            {/* QST */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="invoiceQST"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                QST (9.975%) ($) <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                id="invoiceQST"
                value={formData.qst}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, qst: e.target.value })}
                required
                min="0"
                step="0.01"
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                placeholder="0.00"
                readOnly
              />
            </div>

            {/* Total Price */}
            <div className="form-group">
              <label
                htmlFor="invoiceTotalPrice"
                className="block text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 mb-2"
              >
                Total Price ($) <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                id="invoiceTotalPrice"
                value={formData.totalPrice}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, totalPrice: e.target.value })}
                required
                min="0"
                step="0.01"
                className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800 text-gray-900 dark:text-white font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all"
                placeholder="0.00"
                readOnly
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleClose}
              className="flex-1 px-6 py-3 border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="flex-1 px-6 py-3 bg-primary hover:bg-sky-600 text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <span className="material-icons-outlined animate-spin text-sm">refresh</span>
                  Saving...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">save</span>
                  {invoice ? 'Update Invoice' : 'Create Invoice'}
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export const customerApi = {
  async getAll() {
    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/customers`, {
        signal: controller.signal
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);

        body: JSON.stringify(customer),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error adding customer:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async update(id, customer) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/customers/${id}`, {

        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(customer),

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating customer:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

    }
  },

  async create(customer) {

      }

// Invoice API
export const invoiceApi = {
  async getAll() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async getByCustomer(customerId) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/customer/${customerId}`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching customer invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async create(invoice) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(invoice),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async fetchFilteredInvoices(filters) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/filter`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(filters),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching filtered invoices:', error);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async update(invoiceNumber, invoice) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/invoices/${invoiceNumber}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(invoice),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
};

    try {

          return null;
        }
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching payment:', error);
      return null;
    }
  },

  async create(payment) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/payments`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payment),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        const errorData = await response.json();
        throw new Error(errorData.detail || 'Unknown error');
      }

      return await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating payment:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  },

  async update(paymentId, payment) {
    try {

    }

import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { customerApi, invoiceApi, paymentApi } from '../services/api';
import CustomerModal from '../components/CustomerModal';

const CustomerDashboard = () => {
  const { customerId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (customerId) {
      loadCustomerData();
    }
  }, [customerId]);

  const loadCustomerData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      // Fetch customer details
      const customerData = await customerApi.getById(customerId);
      setCustomer(customerData);

      // Fetch customer invoices
      await loadCustomerInvoices(customerId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading customer data:', err);
      setError('Failed to load customer data. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadCustomerInvoices = async (custId) => {
    try {
      const invoiceList = await invoiceApi.getByCustomer(custId);

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice
      const invoicesWithPayments = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          try {
            const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
            return {
              ...invoice,
              payment,
              payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null
            };
          } catch (err) {
            // If payment not found, continue without it
            return {
              ...invoice,
              payment: null,
              payment_id: null
            };
          }
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithPayments);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      // Don't set error state for invoices, just show empty list
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '—';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const getPaymentStatusClass = (status) => {
    if (!status) return 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300';

    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'paid':
        return 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400';
      case 'pending':
        return 'bg-yellow-100 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400';
      case 'overdue':
        return 'bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';
      default:
        return 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300';
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
        <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Loading customer...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !customer) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-4">
        <p className="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">{error || 'Customer not found'}</p>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/customers')}
          className="px-4 py-2 bg-primary text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-sky-600 transition-colors"
        >
          Back to Customers
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6 pt-2 pr-4 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/customers')}
            className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">arrow_back</span>
          </button>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.name}</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">Customer Dashboard</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Customer Info Card */}
      <div className="bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl p-6 mb-6 mr-4 shadow-sm shrink-0">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">phone</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Phone</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.phone || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">email</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Email</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.email || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">location_on</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Address</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.address || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">note</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Notes</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.notes || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
          <button className="px-6 py-2 bg-primary/10 text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">edit</span>
            Update Customer
          </button>
          <button className="px-6 py-2 bg-green-500/10 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500 hover:text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">add</span>
            Generate Invoice
          </button>
          <button className="px-6 py-2 bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">delete</span>
            Delete Customer
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Invoices Section */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col pr-4">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 shrink-0">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Invoices</h3>
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {invoices.length} {invoices.length === 1 ? 'invoice' : 'invoices'}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-auto bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-sm">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full">
              <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 z-10">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Invoice #</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Month</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Base Price</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">GST</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">QST</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Total</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Payment Status</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Payment Date</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-700">
                {invoices.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="9" className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      No invoices found for this customer.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  invoices.map((invoice) => {
                    const paymentStatus = invoice.payment?.payment_status || 'pending';
                    const paymentDate = invoice.payment?.payment_date
                      ? formatDate(invoice.payment.payment_date)
                      : '—';

                    return (
                      <tr key={invoice.invoice_number} className="hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {invoice.invoice_number}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatDate(invoice.month)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.base_price)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.gst)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.qst)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.total_price)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${getPaymentStatusClass(paymentStatus)}`}>
                            {paymentStatus}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {paymentDate}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <button
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                            title="Edit invoice"
                          >
                            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400 hover:text-primary text-lg">edit</span>
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CustomerDashboard;

export default CustomerDashboard;","originalFile":"import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { customerApi, invoiceApi, paymentApi } from '../services/api';
import CustomerModal from '../components/CustomerModal';

const CustomerDashboard = () => {
  const { customerId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState(null);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [isCustomerModalOpen, setIsCustomerModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (customerId) {
      loadCustomerData();
    }
  }, [customerId]);

  const loadCustomerData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      // Fetch customer details
      const customerData = await customerApi.getById(customerId);
      setCustomer(customerData);

      // Fetch customer invoices
      await loadCustomerInvoices(customerId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading customer data:', err);
      setError('Failed to load customer data. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadCustomerInvoices = async (custId) => {
    try {
      const invoiceList = await invoiceApi.getByCustomer(custId);

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice
      const invoicesWithPayments = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          try {
            const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
            return {
              ...invoice,
              payment,
              payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null
            };
          } catch (err) {
            // If payment not found, continue without it
            return {
              ...invoice,
              payment: null,
              payment_id: null
            };
          }
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithPayments);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      // Don't set error state for invoices, just show empty list
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '—';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString();
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const getPaymentStatusClass = (status) => {
    if (!status) return 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300';

    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'paid':
        return 'bg-green-100 dark:bg-green-900/30 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400';
      case 'pending':
        return 'bg-yellow-100 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400';
      case 'overdue':
        return 'bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';
      default:
        return 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300';
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateCustomer = async (formData) => {
    try {
      await customerApi.update(customerId, formData);
      await loadCustomerData(); // Refresh the customer data
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating customer:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
        <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Loading customer...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !customer) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-4">
        <p className="text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">{error || 'Customer not found'}</p>
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate('/customers')}
          className="px-4 py-2 bg-primary text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-sky-600 transition-colors"
        >
          Back to Customers
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6 pt-2 pr-4 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate('/customers')}
            className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">arrow_back</span>
          </button>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.name}</h2>
            <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">Customer Dashboard</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Customer Info Card */}
      <div className="bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl p-6 mb-6 mr-4 shadow-sm shrink-0">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">phone</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Phone</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.phone || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">email</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Email</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.email || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">location_on</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Address</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.address || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shrink-0">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400">note</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1">Notes</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{customer.notes || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-700">
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsCustomerModalOpen(true)}
            className="px-6 py-2 bg-primary/10 text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">edit</span>
            Update Customer
          </button>
          <button className="px-6 py-2 bg-green-500/10 text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500 hover:text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">add</span>
            Generate Invoice
          </button>
          <button className="px-6 py-2 bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white rounded-xl font-semibold transition-colors flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-sm">delete</span>
            Delete Customer
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Invoices Section */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col pr-4">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 shrink-0">
          <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Invoices</h3>
          <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {invoices.length} {invoices.length === 1 ? 'invoice' : 'invoices'}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-auto bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-sm">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full">
              <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 z-10">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Invoice #</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Month</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Base Price</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">GST</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">QST</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Total</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Payment Status</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Payment Date</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-700">
                {invoices.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan="9" className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                      No invoices found for this customer.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  invoices.map((invoice) => {
                    const paymentStatus = invoice.payment?.payment_status || 'pending';
                    const paymentDate = invoice.payment?.payment_date
                      ? formatDate(invoice.payment.payment_date)
                      : '—';

                    return (
                      <tr key={invoice.invoice_number} className="hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800/50 transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {invoice.invoice_number}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatDate(invoice.month)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.base_price)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.gst)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.qst)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                          {formatCurrency(invoice.total_price)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${getPaymentStatusClass(paymentStatus)}`}>
                            {paymentStatus}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                          {paymentDate}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">
                          <button
                            className="p-1.5 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                            title="Edit invoice"
                          >
                            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400 hover:text-primary text-lg">edit</span>
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

            payment_status: payment?.payment_status || 'pending',

import { invoiceApi, customerApi, paymentApi } from '../services/api';
import InvoiceModal from '../components/InvoiceModal';

const Invoices = () => {
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [isInvoiceModalOpen, setIsInvoiceModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCustomerSelectOpen, setIsCustomerSelectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCustomerId, setSelectedCustomerId] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAllInvoices();
    loadCustomers();
  }, []);

  const loadAllInvoices = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);

      // Fetch invoices
      const invoiceList = await invoiceApi.getAll();

      // Fetch all customers to create a mapping of customer_id to customer_name
      const customers = await customerApi.getAll();
      const customerMap = {};
      customers.forEach(customer => {
        customerMap[customer.customer_id] = customer.name;
      });

      // Fetch payment information for each invoice and combine the data
      const invoicesWithDetails = await Promise.all(
        invoiceList.map(async (invoice) => {
          const payment = await paymentApi.getByInvoice(invoice.invoice_number);
          return {
            ...invoice,
            customer_name: customerMap[invoice.customer_id] || 'Unknown Customer',
            payment_id: payment?.payment_id || null,
            payment_status: payment?.payment_status || 'pending',
            payment_date: payment?.payment_date || null
          };
        })
      );

      setInvoices(invoicesWithDetails);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading invoices:', err);
      setError('Failed to load invoices. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '-';
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  };

  const formatCurrency = (value) => {
    return `$${parseFloat(value).toFixed(2)}`;
  };

  const loadCustomers = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await customerApi.getAll();
      setCustomers(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading customers:', err);
    }
  };

  const getPaymentStatusStyle = (status) => {
    const styles = {
      paid: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
      pending: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-400',
      loss: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
    };
    return styles[status?.toLowerCase()] || styles.pending;
  };

  const handleAddInvoice = async (invoiceData) => {
    try {
      await invoiceApi.create(invoiceData);
      await loadAllInvoices(); // Refresh the list
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating invoice:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  };

  const handleOpenInvoiceModal = () => {
    setIsCustomerSelectOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCustomerSelect = (customerId) => {
    setSelectedCustomerId(customerId);
    setIsCustomerSelectOpen(false);
    setIsInvoiceModalOpen(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 pt-2 pr-4 shrink-0">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">Invoice Management</h2>
          <p className="text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 mt-1">Manage and track your customer invoices.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="relative hidden sm:block">
            <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-3">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-gray-400 text-sm">search</span>
            </span>
            <input className="pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-full border-none bg-white dark:bg-card-dark shadow-sm text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary w-64 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200" placeholder="Search invoices..." type="text"/>
          </div>
          <button className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-card-dark rounded-full shadow-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:text-primary transition-colors relative">
            <span className="material-icons-outlined">notifications</span>
            <span className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-2 h-2 bg-red-500 rounded-full"></span>
          </button>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-300 overflow-hidden border-2 border-white dark:border-gray-700 shadow-sm">
            <img alt="Profile" className="w-full h-full object-cover" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDPthKT8vmwawHExPW3xkBr-Ql6dfwnZR4_mFxsnVAjligDy0HZmjlI_EV-6IR8LtrU9h1Anhfe_yjtxhxsP8iUq9db89yZ5Pq2imJmV-sIbuq_LnEYOPMk5pDIFN3WP7SM9uylJqgphz4M4_juqc-v-CYYoEznshFJ9xeahK1GBrWt7ixGnn6jlRX60xTfo8d-nZFuPZkL-uhzPtJDurY2Y0pIHSEwflCB-GWYno-Rr9_WhOwAb3jXp7DvQzcyxmPoUbXTEPys0UU"/>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div className="bg-card-light dark:bg-card-dark rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex flex-col flex-1 overflow-hidden pr-4">
        <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
            <div className="p-2 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 rounded-xl text-primary">
              <span className="material-icons-outlined text-2xl">receipt</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">All Invoices</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">Total {invoices.length} invoices</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleOpenInvoiceModal}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-primary hover:bg-sky-600 text-white font-medium rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span className="material-icons-outlined text-lg">add</span>
            Add Invoice
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-auto flex-1">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400">
            <thead className="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800 text-xs uppercase font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-sm">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Invoice Number</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Customer</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Base Price</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">QST (9.975%)</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">GST (5%)</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Payment Status</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Payment Date</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800" scope="col">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 dark:divide-gray-800">
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    Loading invoices...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : error ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8">
                    <div className="text-center">
                      <p className="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</p>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : invoices.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-8 text-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                    No invoices found.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                invoices.map((invoice, index) => (
                  <tr key={invoice.invoice_number} className={`${index % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-white dark:bg-gray-900' : 'bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-800/50'} hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors`}>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{invoice.invoice_number}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
                          {invoice.customer_name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).join('').toUpperCase().substring(0, 2)}
                        </div>
                        <span>{invoice.customer_name}</span>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-900 dark:text-white font-medium">{formatCurrency(invoice.base_price)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatCurrency(invoice.qst)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatCurrency(invoice.gst)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <span className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold capitalize ${getPaymentStatusStyle(invoice.payment_status)}`}>
                        {invoice.payment_status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">{formatDate(invoice.payment_date)}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <button className="text-gray-400 hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        <span className="material-icons-outlined">more_vert</span>
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-gray-100 dark:border-gray-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">

            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 font-medium text-sm transition-colors">10</button>
            <button className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors">
